fusions.name: Bounding Kick
fusions.desc: A leaping kick at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Startle Buck
fusions.desc: Kicks out in every direction, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 30% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Spooked Bolt
fusions.desc: Bolts 5 tiles in the direction you are facing, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Skittish
fusions.desc: Each blow you take builds a stack, up to 4. At 4, they are spent at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
